limitations.adjacent_lists_markers: Two adjacent lists that differ only in bullet marker are written with the same marker and read back as one list.
limitations.reference_link: Link reference definitions are not modeled. The parser reports the line, the renderer drops it, and the link stops resolving.
limitations.setext_heading_two_lines: A setext heading that spans two lines is written as a one-line heading with a space where the line break was.
limitations.lazy_line_looks_like_table: Lines that continue a quote lazily (no > marker) and look like a table come back as a table. The Phase 1 renderer left continuation lines unmarked and passed this case; marking every line is what lets ordinary two-line quotes round-trip byte for byte.
limitations.lazy_line_looks_like_table_in_item: The same for a list item: lazy lines that look like a table are indented on the way out and come back as a table. Indenting continuation lines is what lets ordinary two-line items round-trip byte for byte.

normalizations.empty_document: an empty document renders as a single newline
normalizations.indented_code: an indented code block is written as a fence
normalizations.nested_fence: a ~~~ fence is written with four backticks because the code contains ```
normalizations.setext_heading_trailing_hash: setext headings are written as # headings; a trailing # is escaped
normalizations.setext_headings: setext headings are written as # headings
normalizations.table_alignment: table padding and separator rows are rewritten
normalizations.table_ragged_rows: short rows are padded to the header width; cells beyond it are dropped, as GFM ignores them
